SignUp.linkIntro: All we need is your email — we will send you a link to sign in with. The account is created automatically; you can fill in the rest of your profile later.
SignUp.passwordIntro: Create the account with a password — you will then sign in with your email and password. No link will be sent to your inbox.
SignUp.setPasswordToggle: I want to set a password right away
SignUp.backToLinkToggle: Back to signing in with a link
SignUp.linkNotArrivedUsePassword: Link not arrived? Set a password instead
SignUp.emailAlreadyUsed: This email is already used by {{name}}. If the account is yours, you can recover your password on the

GameDetail.gameNotFound: Game not found. It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
GameDetail.deletedGameNotice: This game is deleted — only editors and administrators can see it. You can restore it.

Calendar.pageDescription: Every larp event in one calendar — weekends, a month grid and the archive.
Calendar.subscribeHint: You can also subscribe to just what interests you: pick the games you want to play in your profile and get your own calendar link.
Calendar.stripHint: Click a month to see only its events.
Calendar.filteredHint: The filter trims free weekends too, so weeks that look empty may still appear.

filters.queryHint: Searches the loaded events by name and place, diacritics are ignored.
filters.registrationNone: No event has an open registration filled in, so this filter has nothing to show.
filters.labelsNone: None of the {{total}} upcoming events has a label, the filter would come up empty.
filters.placeHeuristic: There is no country column, "abroad" is read from the location text or the event name.

monthGrid.legend: A teal bar is a one-day event, a grey bar with a teal edge spans several days (it runs across the days).

history.title: Events per year
history.subtitle: {{total}} events in the database · {{past}} played · {{future}} scheduled
history.legend: Grey is played, green is scheduled. The small squares show the months of the year.
history.emptyYears: The years {{years}} are missing entirely — the database holds no event for them.
history.noEvents: No events for this year in the database.

EventEdit.registrationUrlHint: Direct link to the registration form or ticket sales
EventEdit.registrationStatusHint: The sign-up state; you can fill in the link later by editing the event
EventEdit.registrationOpenHint: Enable only while people can register using the link
EventEdit.registrationUrlRequiredWhenOpen: A link is required when registration is open
EventEdit.coverImageHint: Optional preview shown in the calendar (ideally 10:3, max 2 MB)

Catalog.pageDescription: Every larp in the database. Filter by labels, year, duration, number of players and rating.
Catalog.subtitle: {{count}} larps match the filter · the link keeps your filter

filters.title: Filter
filters.queryHint: Neither diacritics nor the word order matter: „novak jozef“ finds „Jozef Novák“.

Cookies.text: We use Google Analytics to see which pages of the database are actually used. Without your consent we only collect cookieless, anonymous data.

YearReview.pageTitle: The year {{year}} on the larp scene
YearReview.pageDescription: The games people talked about, the votes that ranked them and the texts written about them — the yearbook of one calendar year.
YearReview.featuredSubtitle: The three most-discussed games of the year, with the community recommendation bands instead of numbers.
YearReview.runnerUpSubtitle: More of the year's strongest-voted games, with the same rating badge the rest of the site uses.
YearReview.newGamesSubtitle: Everything added to the catalog during the year, January to December. The badge is the recommendation band (grey = too few votes).
YearReview.quotesTitle: Reviews and comments of the year
YearReview.quotesSubtitle: Quotes from the reviews the year added — the longest one per game.
YearReview.articlesSubtitle: Texts from the Czech larp sites CSLD follows and links to.
YearReview.footNote: Games ranked by the votes they received during the year; quotes are each game's longest review. Community ratings are shown as recommendation bands, like everywhere on the site.

Statistics.pageDescription: How larps and their ratings changed over the years — events, games and votes, year by year.
Statistics.eventsSubtitle: Green: unique events; the grey shadow is every calendar record, import duplicates included.
Statistics.ratingsSubtitle: Share of votes per recommendation band, from 2015 on. Older votes arrived in the one-time import of 1 Jun 2014 — the rating charts omit them.
Statistics.averageTitle: Average rating and number of votes
Statistics.averageSubtitle: A vote's year is the year it was added, not the year the event ran.
Statistics.yearbooksSubtitle: What the scene lived through that year — the games people talked about, the reviews and comments, in one story.
Statistics.newGamesSubtitle: How many games were added each year.
Statistics.notesTitle: How we arrived at the numbers

notes.events: Events: unique name + date combinations ({{raw}} calendar records, {{unique}} unique events).
notes.import: Ratings: a vote's year is when it was added. {{count}} votes of 2014 arrived in a single import on 1 Jun 2014 — marked in the charts.
notes.live: Only live records count: deleted games and events are not in the numbers.
notes.since: The charts show 2015 and later. Older data arrived in the one-time import of 2014 and would say more about the database's history than about the community.
